summary:
I validated SL-043 against the real system drive and against the freshly published exe, all non-elevated (Medium integrity).

**Test suite:** the Release suite passed 240/240.

**Whole-drive comparison:** a scratch probe used only the public Core API. It scanned all of C:\ and compared the store with two independent FindFirstFileExW walks, one before the scan and one after.
- Result: 4,438,929 entries were seen by both walks. All of them are in the store, and all have the same kind (link, folder or file) as the walk gave.
- Nothing is duplicated.
- There are 20,464 links. None has children, and no store entry sits below anything the walks called a link.
- 663 folders were unreadable: 633 with error 5, 28 with error 363 and 2 with error 1920. They are the same folders, with the same codes, that failed in both walks, and the scan still Completed.
- 3 store entries were in neither walk. All three were transient files: a Chrome cache entry, a OneDrive log, and a harness output file that no longer exists. The probe's own strict RESULT line said FAIL because of those three.
- The recorded volume figure fell inside the Get-Volume before/after bracket with no slack needed. It was 241,664 B above the before read and 954,368 B below the after read.

**C:\ProgramData:** the same comparison matched exactly: 257,980 entries, 10 links, 565 folders with error 5.

**Shipped exe:** I did one real publish. The exe scanned all of C:\ in 464 s and reported Completed, 20,464 links not followed and 663 unreadable folders. Its volume line said 771.5 GB in use, and Get-Volume read 771.5 GiB afterwards. Window cases P-001 (paths to 498 characters) and V-001 (SUBST drive root versus folder path) passed.

**O-014 (owed here):** under an adversarial 256–300 MiB write-then-delete loop, the bracket test passed 20 of 20 runs. The precondition itself broke once: in one first attempt the figure fell outside the bracket, and the test's retry absorbed it.

**Still open, owed to build-slice:**
- O-024: tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 C-003, C-004 and C-005 still exit 1 at HEAD.
- O-025: MainWindow.ShowVolumeInUse still has the IsCompleted shortcut at MainWindow.xaml.cs:403-404, so its pending branch is exercised by nothing.

The tree is unchanged apart from the pre-existing .taad files, and every scratch folder I made in %TEMP% has been deleted.

checks.evidence:
trx: total 240, executed 240, passed 240, failed 0. Named results:
- TraversalTests.AgreesWithAnIndependentListingOfADeepTreeAsAnOrdinaryUser: passed.

- LinkTests.JunctionsAndSymlinksAreRecordedAndNeverEntered: passed.
- HardlinkTests (3,2): passed.
- SynchronousIoCancelTests: the 363 and 1920 rows passed.
- VolumeUsageTests: all passed. Bracket attempt 1: Get-Volume before 828,555,022,336, figure 828,555,022,336, after 828,555,014,144, inside. GetDiskFreeSpaceExW(Y:\) failed with error 3. The stall test took 5.0 s.

The network-tagged SMB tests are excluded by the default filter.

checks.what: First probe launch through the framework-dependent apphost
checks.evidence: 'You must install or update .NET': the apphost looked in C:\Program Files\dotnet, which has only runtimes 6, 8 and 9. I re-ran it as the repo-local .dotnet\dotnet.exe probe.dll. This is an environment fact, not a product defect.

checks.what: Real dataset C:\ProgramData: store compared with two independent FindFirstFileExW walks (before and after the scan), non-elevated
checks.command: dotnet probe.dll C:\ProgramData (scratch project in %TEMP% referencing the Release FsAnalyser.Core.dll, public API only)
checks.evidence: walk1: 257,980 entries, 143,538 dirs. The scan Completed, count 257,981 including the root, links=10, unreadable=565. Both walks agree on all 257,980 entries (none seen by only one walk), and every one is in the store. No store entry is in neither walk, and no kinds disagree. No link has children, and no store entry lies below a link. No path is duplicated. Unreadable: 565 folders with error 5, the same set and codes as the walks' failures. Volume figure: null (a folder root). RESULT PASS.

checks.what: Real dataset, the whole C:\ drive: store compared with two independent walks, non-elevated
checks.command: dotnet probe.dll C:\ (started detached with Start-Process; an earlier run under the tool's 10-minute limit was stopped by me before it finished)
checks.evidence:
walk1: 4,438,940 entries, 829,747 dirs, 663 failures, 319.5 s. The scan Completed in 478.3 s: count 4,438,944, files 3,588,731, folders 829,748, links 20,464, unreadable 663, FileIds available. walk2: 829,747 dirs, 663 failures.

Comparison:
- 4,438,929 entries were in both walks. None is missing from the store, and no kinds disagree. 22 entries were in only one walk (churn).
- 3 store entries were in neither walk: a Chrome cache file, a OneDrive ListSync log, and a harness task output file. That last file no longer exists. The other two I could not re-check, because the guard refuses browser-profile paths. The probe's strict RESULT line therefore printed FAIL, and I discount it as live churn.
- No link has children. No store entry lies below any of the walks' 20,464 links. No path is duplicated.
- Unreadable folders: 633 with error 5, 28 with 363 and 2 with 1920 in both the scan and the walks. All 663 failed in both walks, all are recorded by the scan, and no code differs.

checks.evidence: figure 828,427,575,296; Get-Volume before 828,427,333,632; after 828,428,529,664. Figure minus before = 241,664 B; after minus figure = 954,368 B. The figure is inside [before, after] without the 64 MiB slack.

checks.evidence: 10/10 runs exited 0, each inside on attempt 1. Drift within a window reached -318,767,104 B, monotone, so the figure equalled the before read.

checks.what: O-014: the bracket test under a harsher 256 MiB write, hold 0.25 s, delete, gap 0.25 s loop
checks.command: 10 x the same filtered test run
checks.evidence: 10/10 runs exited 0. Run 6, attempt 1 was OUTSIDE: before 828,700,962,816, figure 828,432,527,360, after 828,721,803,264. That is non-monotone: the file was deleted before the figure and written again before the after read. Attempt 2 was inside with 0 drift. The other 9 runs were inside on attempt 1. criteria.criterion: 1. Scan a tree and compare the store with an independent recursive listing: folders and files past 260 characters, the deepest over 400, no links, non-elevated process
criteria.how: TraversalTests.AgreesWithAnIndependentListingOfADeepTreeAsAnOrdinaryUser passed in Release. It asserts IsPrivilegedProcess is false, a folder path over 260 and a file path over 400, and equal sorted path sets. On real data: C:\ProgramData (257,980 entries) and all of C:\ (4,438,929 stable entries) matched two independent FindFirstFileExW walks, non-elevated.

criteria.criterion: 2. The same comparison when the tree contains a hidden file and a hidden folder
criteria.how: The same Fact passed. It asserts both hidden entries are in the store with the Hidden attribute, and that the reference listing uses AttributesToSkip=0. The real C:\ comparison also counts hidden and system entries: the walks skip nothing.

criteria.criterion: 3. The not-elevated check when the token is elevated (TokenIsElevated=1)
criteria.how: This needs an elevated run of the project's tests, which is a session and not a named operation. The design marked it non-material.

criteria.criterion: 4. Classify as link: reparse attribute plus a surrogate-bit tag (0xA0000003, 0xA000000C dir and file, 0xA000001D file, 0xA0000010 dir)
criteria.how: EntryClassifierTests.ANameSurrogateTagWithTheReparseAttributeIsALink passed. EntryClassifier.cs tests the attribute and then (tag & 0x20000000). On real data, all 20,464 C:\ links agree with a classification from FindFirstFileExW's own tag field, and none was entered.

criteria.criterion: 5. Classify as data: reparse attribute plus a non-surrogate tag (the four cloud tags, tag 0, DFS 0x8000000A; file and dir)
criteria.how: EntryClassifierTests.ANonSurrogateTagWithTheReparseAttributeIsData passed, with 12 rows. On real C:\ no entry disagreed in kind with the independent walk. Real cloud-tagged entries are not visible to a standalone .NET process (U-004), so the cloud rows rest on the table test.

criteria.criterion: 6. Tag field has 0x20000000 but the reparse attribute is clear
7. Record an unreadable folder and continue: 363 or 1920, with and without a requested cancel (5 and 995 alongside)
criteria.how: SynchronousIoCancelTests rows 363 and 1920 (both cancel states) passed as Unreadable. On real data, the C:\ scan recorded 28 folders with 363 and 2 with 1920, plus 633 with 5, and Completed. These are the same folders and codes the independent walks failed on.

criteria.criterion: 8. Record used space of a drive-root scan: system drive, cancelled right after the figure lands, Get-Volume read before and after
criteria.how: ASystemDriveScanRecordsWhatGetVolumeReports passed: idle, and 20/20 runs under a concurrent 256-300 MiB write-delete load. On real data, the probe's uncancelled C:\ scan figure fell inside the Get-Volume before/after reads with no slack.

criteria.criterion: 9. Record used space of a folder scan (not a drive root)
criteria.how: AFolderScanRecordsNoFigure passed. The C:\ProgramData probe got a figure of null. V-001's folder-path ending has no volume line.

criteria.criterion: 10. Decide whether a root is a drive root (C:\, c:\, \\?\C:\, C:\Users, UNC forms, a volume mounted on a folder)
criteria.how: The OnlyAWholeDriveIsADriveRoot theory passed, 9 rows. It is a string test only: no real mounted-folder volume was reached.

criteria.criterion: 11. A drive letter with no volume behind it: GetDiskFreeSpaceExW returns false
criteria.how: ADriveLetterWithNoVolumeRecordsNoFigure passed. GetDiskFreeSpaceExW(Y:\) failed with error 3, and the figure is null, not faulted.

criteria.criterion: 12. End a drive-root scan while the volume read is stalled and the scan is cancelled
criteria.how: ADriveRootScanEndsWhileTheReadIsStalled passed in 5.0 s: Cancelled before the bound, then null at the bound. AStalledReadKeepsNoDroppedScanInMemory passed.

criteria.criterion: 13. A tree past 260 characters read by the published single-file exe, which has no longPathAware manifest
criteria.how: Window case P-001 passed on the exe I published at validate (folders to 457 characters, files to 498).

criteria.criterion: 14. The App shows the used figure for a drive-root scan from store.VolumeUsed, with MainWindow's DriveInfo call deleted
criteria.how: The exe's real C:\ run showed 'The volume reports 771.5 GB in use', and Get-Volume read 771.5 GiB. V-001 passed. Only the synchronous branch of ShowVolumeInUse was exercised; the pending branch is O-025, which is still open.

planned.evidence: TraversalTests.AgreesWithAnIndependentListingOfADeepTreeAsAnOrdinaryUser passed in Release. It confirms non-elevation, folders over 260 and files over 400 characters, and equal path sets with an independent BCL listing that skips nothing. On real data I checked against two FindFirstFileExW walks, non-elevated. C:\ProgramData: all 257,980 entries, exact match. All of C:\: 4,438,929 stable entries all present, each once, same kind. The only store extras were 3 live-churn files.
Cut as already built. HardlinkTests.AFileWithSeveralNamesIsChargedOnceAtItsTrueSize, including the three-name case (names: 3, writtenThrough: 2), passed in this Release run.

Cut as already built. LinkTests.JunctionsAndSymlinksAreRecordedAndNeverEntered passed in this Release run. On real data, the C:\ scan recorded 20,464 links, none with children and no store entry below any of them, and it Completed.

The EntryClassifierTests table passed: the four cloud tags and tag 0 are descended (Folder/File), and junction and symlink are Link. The code reads the attribute first, then (tag & 0x20000000). On real C:\, no kind disagreed with an independent tag-based walk over 4.4M entries. Cloud tags cannot be seen from a standalone .NET process (U-004), so only the table covers them.

UnreadableFolderTests (an ACL denies list access; error 5 is recorded and the siblings are counted) passed, as did the 363 and 1920 classification rows. On the real C:\ scan, 663 folders were recorded with path and code (633 with 5, 28 with 363, 2 with 1920), exactly the set and codes the independent walks failed on. The scan Completed.

The VolumeUsageTests Get-Volume bracket passed, idle and in 20/20 runs under concurrent write-delete load. On real C:\ the figure fell inside Get-Volume before/after (+241,664 B / -954,368 B). The shipped exe's line said 771.5 GB, and Get-Volume said 771.5 GiB.

obligations.evidence:
Measured under concurrent write load on C: while the bracket test ran.
- Load 1: 300 MiB written, held 1.5 s, deleted, 1.5 s gap. 10/10 runs passed on attempt 1, with monotone drift up to -318,767,104 B.
- Load 2: 256 MiB written, held 0.25 s, deleted, 0.25 s gap. 10/10 runs passed. In one first attempt (run 6) the drift was non-monotone and the figure fell outside the bracket (before 828,700,962,816, figure 828,432,527,360, after 828,721,803,264), so the precondition as stated does not always hold under adversarial churn. The test's three-attempt retry absorbed it: attempt 2 was inside.
- Idle suite run: attempt 1 inside, 0 drift.
The test is reliable at validate even under a write-delete load harsher than an SDK download.

Owed to build-slice and not done. RuleCases.ps1 still exits 1 at HEAD for C-003 (4 failures, including 'DRIFT 1 unpaired'), C-004 (expects 'AGREE 8 facts <- 11 twinned entries, 23 patterns') and C-005 ('found 8 Facts where the test class has 9'). Nothing under src or tests changed after the code review.

Owed to build-slice and not done. MainWindow.xaml.cs:403-404 still takes the synchronous `figure.IsCompleted` shortcut, so the ContinueWith and Dispatcher.InvokeAsync branch stays unexercised. V-001 and the real C:\ exe run both completed the figure before ShowOutcome.

not_reached: The pending branch of MainWindow.ShowVolumeInUse. It needs a drive-root scan whose volume answers after the scan ends, such as a mapped share that stalls. StallRig serves a UNC share with no drive letter, and every local read landed first.

A DFS namespace or referral. No DFS is reachable here, so the accepted consequence is unmeasured: descending DFS follows the referral over SMB into another server, whose FileIds mix with local ones in one table.

Real entries carrying the cloud tags 0x9000201A/401A/601A/E01A. A standalone .NET process on this PC sees OneDrive placeholders as plain entries with tag 0 (U-004), so those rows are checked only by the classifier table.
The elevated-token case: the non-elevation assertion failing when the test runs elevated. That needs a session of the project's own code run as administrator.
A real volume mounted on a folder, and a SUBST letter or share-subfolder mapping that reports its host volume's figure (m3). IsDriveRoot was checked only on strings.
A whole-drive scan of an empty removable drive, where the scanner's own root open lacks SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS and could raise the 'insert a disk' box.
Windows 10. Only Windows 11 build 26200 was available.
The opt-in SMB-loopback and TEST-NET-1 network tests and window cases N-001..N-004.
